name: hcportal_getCities
description: Returns the cities for a given region from HC.City, ordered alphabetically by CityName. Used to populate the cascading Country -> Region -> City selector in the run editor. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (device-bound token, NULL callerParamString); no kennel permission gate — any authenticated portal user may call it.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Filter: only non-removed cities whose RegionId matches are returned. NULL returns an empty list (no error).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of the result rowset on auth failure or a runtime error from the CATCH block.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error text (NVARCHAR(255) from ValidatePortalAuth), validation message, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block

rowsets.name: CitiesResult
rowsets.description: Cities for the given region where City.Removed = 0, ordered by CityName. Empty when @regionId is NULL (RegionId = NULL matches nothing).

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH block (line 49) returns the Success=0 envelope with ERROR_MESSAGE() but writes no HC.ErrorLog row, so a runtime failure (timeout, deadlock) is invisible server-side unless the API shim logs it. CLAUDE.md: every CATCH must log to HC.ErrorLog.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
